environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has three AWS WAF rule groups attached in evaluation order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-uri-allowlist' that blocks requests to paths not matching /api/* or /health with a priority of 100, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. The WAF web ACL has CloudWatch metrics enabled with sampled requests. ALB access logs are shipped to S3. The ECS task role has no network egress except to the ALB target group. A VPC endpoint policy restricts S3 access to the specific logging bucket ARN only.

config.load_balancer: ALB with AWS WAF v2 web ACL attached
config.network: ECS Fargate, no public IP, egress restricted via security group to ALB only
